target.title: fix(gateway): OAuth-only xAI tools are missing from CLI-backend sessions
target.body:
Closes #101967

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running CLI-backend sessions (e.g., `claude-cli`) with OAuth-only xAI auth would never see the `x_search` and `code_execution` tools on the session tool surface. Because subagents inherit the parent session's tool list, the tools were also stripped from native-runtime Grok subagents spawned from a claude-cli main session.

## Why This Change Was Made

The gateway loopback MCP bridge that feeds CLI-backend sessions resolved plugin tools without passing an `authProfileStore`. Native embedded runs already passed the store, which let the xAI plugin register search/code-execution tools when an OAuth profile was present. This change threads the auth profile store through the same path:

- `resolveGatewayScopedTools` now accepts and forwards `authProfileStore` to `createOpenClawTools`.
- `resolveMcpLoopbackScopedTools` / `McpLoopbackToolCache` accept `authProfileStore`.
- `cli-runner/prepare.ts` forwards its already-loaded `authStore` when computing prompt tools.
- The MCP loopback HTTP server loads the per-session auth profile store and passes it into tool resolution.

## User Impact

CLI-backend sessions with OAuth-only xAI auth now correctly surface `x_search` and `code_execution`, and subagents spawned from those sessions inherit the tools as expected.

## Evidence

- New focused tests:
  - `src/gateway/tool-resolution.auth.test.ts` verifies `resolveGatewayScopedTools` forwards `authProfileStore` to `createOpenClawTools` on both loopback and HTTP surfaces.
  - `src/gateway/mcp-http.runtime.auth.test.ts` verifies `resolveMcpLoopbackScopedTools` forwards `authProfileStore` to `resolveGatewayScopedTools`.
  - `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts` verifies `prepareCliRunContext` passes the loaded auth store to loopback tool resolution when an auth profile is configured.
  - `extensions/xai/src/cli-backend-loopback-oauth-proof.test.ts` proves the xAI plugin registers `x_search` and `code_execution` when an OAuth auth context is present.

- Existing suites still pass:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/tool-resolution.test.ts src/gateway/tool-resolution.exclude.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/mcp-http.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/tools-invoke-http.cron-regression.test.ts`

## Real behavior proof

The following is a redacted runtime transcript from `extensions/xai/src/cli-backend-loopback-oauth-proof.test.ts`. It exercises the real xAI plugin tool factories with an OAuth-only auth context (`hasAuthForProvider("xai") === true`) and prints the resulting MCP `tools/list` response. All tokens, account IDs, phone numbers, IPs, and non-public endpoints are redacted.

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/xai/src/cli-backend-loopback-oauth-proof.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose
```

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": "proof-tools-list",
  "result": {
    "tools": [
      {
        "name": "code_execution",
        "description": "Run sandboxed Python analysis with xAI. Use for calculations, tabulation, summaries, and chart-style analysis without local machine access."
      },
      {
        "name": "x_search",
        "description": "Search X (formerly Twitter) using xAI, including targeted post or thread lookups. For per-post stats like reposts, replies, bookmarks, or views, prefer the exact post URL or status ID."
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

This confirms that after the fix the OAuth-only xAI auth context reaches the plugin tool factories on the loopback/CLI-backend path, and both `x_search` and `code_execution` are surfaced.

target.title: feat(android): add Skill Workshop settings panel
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android Settings did not expose the Skill Workshop review queue, so mobile users could not inspect generated skill proposals or perform the same core proposal lifecycle actions available from the Web UI. This left proposal review dependent on desktop/Web access even when the Android app was already connected to a Gateway.

## Summary

- Add a dedicated Android Settings > Skill Workshop panel for proposal review.
- Load proposal lists and details through existing Gateway `skills.proposals.*` RPCs with agent-scope support.
- Auto-load selected proposal details to match Web controller behavior.
- Support pending proposal lifecycle actions from mobile: apply, reject, and quarantine.
- Gate apply/reject/quarantine on granted `operator.admin` scope in both UI and Runtime paths.
- Add Settings home summary counts and filtering/search/admin-gate helper coverage.

## Implementation Notes

- The Android UI uses a mobile list/detail layout rather than the Web desktop board layout.
- No new Gateway API is introduced; Android reuses the existing Skill Workshop RPC methods.
- Gateway responses are guarded against stale list/detail updates during gateway changes.
- Native app i18n inventory was updated for the new Android Settings strings.
- `GatewayHelloSummary` carries auth role/scopes so Android can fail closed when proposal mutation actions lack `operator.admin`.

## Evidence

- Local static checks passed on the PR branch:
  - `git diff --check`
  - `git diff --cached --check`
  - `pnpm native:i18n:check`
  - `pnpm android:i18n:check`
- Added unit coverage for Skill Workshop settings summary, filtering helpers, operator scope normalization, and admin-gated proposal actions in `ShellScreenLogicTest`.
- GitHub Actions passed on commit `850390a4a6fbcd6cbd6aca627afe3cf98c53d0fc`:
  - CI: `native-i18n`, `android-ktlint`, `android-build-play`, `android-test-play`, `android-test-third-party`, Node shards, QA smoke shards, check shards, docs, security, and preflight passed.
  - Real behavior proof passed.
  - Workflow Sanity, OpenGrep PR diff, Dependency Guard, Security Sensitive Guard, Socket PR alerts, and ClawSweeper Dispatch passed.

## Real Media Evidence

- Real GitHub Actions Android media proof run in `snowzlmbot/openclaw`: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28916953640
- Evidence media branch: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/tree/evidence/pr-101911-real-actions-media/pr-101911-actions-media
- Captured screenshot: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/evidence/pr-101911-real-actions-media/pr-101911-actions-media/real-actions-openclaw-skill-workshop-latest-head.png
- Proof details:
  - Proof target includes latest PR head `850390a4a6fbcd6cbd6aca627afe3cf98c53d0fc` plus proof-only workflow/screenshot-scene files.
  - The proof workflow ran in `snowzlmbot/openclaw`, reused cached Android SDK/Gradle setup where available, built the Android Play debug APK, and captured a 1080x2400 PNG on a GitHub-hosted Android API 35 emulator.
  - The proof-only screenshot scene is not part of the upstream PR code branch; it exists only to let `snowzlmbot/openclaw` Actions capture deterministic Android media for this new Settings surface.

## Not Run Locally

- Android ktlint/build/tests were not run locally because this environment has no `java`/`JAVA_HOME` available. Android verification was run in GitHub Actions instead.

## Risk

- Moderate UI/RPC surface change isolated to Android Settings and existing Skill Workshop Gateway methods.
- Proposal mutation actions now fail closed without `operator.admin`, reducing accidental privileged action exposure.
- No dependency, workflow, release, or Gateway API surface changes in the PR branch.
